paper_title: Dark Matter Axion Search with HAYSTAC Phase II
notes: HAYSTAC Phase II squeezed-state receiver axion search. Results reported as |g_gamma| relative to KSVZ: 2.75x KSVZ over 17.28-18.44 ueV (Phase IId), 2.96x KSVZ over 18.71-19.46 ueV (Phase IIc), and 2.86x KSVZ combined over 16.96-19.46 ueV at 90% CL. Local DM density rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3. The data_points are approximate absolute g_agamma values in GeV^-1, computed from the KSVZ coupling scaling (g_KSVZ ~ 2e-16 * m_a[ueV]) multiplied by the quoted KSVZ factors; the paper itself plots |g_gamma/g_KSVZ| vs mass, so absolute values carry conversion uncertainty.
